suite_selection_select is not a usable narrowing mechanism for this task's phases. Its grep-based basename stratum maps any path whose basename is SKILL.md or README.md to 28-43 suites by basename collision (verified: founder/skills set -> 28 suites, small-extensions set -> 43), so a suite-subset Tier Justification would be both impractical to write and not a real narrowing; and claiming __FULL_SWEEP__ for those sets would be false. Grounded every phase's Tier Justification in the --only-gate mechanism instead, which plan-format.md explicitly places outside the suite-selection measurement check's scope.

Closed Phase 15 as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] rather than [COMPLETED] or [PARTIAL].

Two of my own foreground verify-deploy.sh re-runs, attempted to independently double-check the already-confirmed deploy-headless.sh result, were auto-backgrounded by the harness and left orphaned under systemd --user (their Bash-tool-level timeout had not been raised past the 120s default, or the shell-level timeout's SIGTERM was not honored by a descendant). The orphaned trees (plus heavy concurrent sibling-task test-suite activity from this same multi-task /orchestrate batch) caused severe gate-lock contention on specs/.gate-lock (verify-deploy-gate8), stalling further verify-deploy.sh invocations at their very first line for 500+ seconds. Diagnosed via ps/pstree, killed the orphaned trees (kill -9), and confirmed the gate-lock's recorded holder pid was already dead so the lock self-reaps. Recovered by relying on the FIRST, already-complete deploy-headless.sh run's captured output instead of re-running the heavy sweep, consistent with this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive (gate 8 / tests/run-all.sh is --skip-slow-deferred by deploy-headless.sh by design; the dispatch explicitly defers the full/slow gate set to the once-per-batch orchestrator-level run).
